name: Sicilian Defense

orientation.basis: opening-name convention; both sides remain available for study

ar.why: يراقب مربعات المركز: d5. يضع قطعة في المركز. حافظ على دعمها. يوسّع خطوط القطع الموجودة على f1, d1.

en.why: Controls central squares: d5. Occupies a central square. Keep it supported. Opens more lines for pieces on f1, d1.
en.watch: A pawn advance cannot be reversed; watch the squares it leaves behind.
